name: Livingstone crosses Africa
traveler: David Livingstone and his Makololo companions
summary: A Scottish missionary-doctor, with men lent by the Makololo chief Sekeletu, walks from the upper Zambezi to the Atlantic, then back across the whole continent to the Indian Ocean. Along the way he is shown Mosi-oa-Tunya, which he names Victoria Falls.

stops.note: Sekeletu provides 27 men for the journey west.
Reaches the Atlantic, exhausted, and turns back to bring his companions home.
Back with his companions, as promised, a year later.
'The smoke that thunders.' He names it after his queen.
A Portuguese outpost on the lower Zambezi.
The Indian Ocean: the first recorded crossing of southern Africa by a European.
